result.reason: The clause reaches at least the fallback position, and is more protective of Customer because Contractor remains subject to consent even for successor assignments. It also provides the preferred Customer affiliate/M&A carve-outs and bars termination following Customer's change of control. It does not reach the full preferred position because it lacks an express prohibition on assignment by Contractor to a Customer competitor. The added prohibition on re-pricing is not required by the playbook, so the redline is not strictly minimal, and the margin comment fails to disclose that additional change. The operative language is otherwise clear and professionally drafted.
